scope: qualification-sized execution of the added EuroSys experiments

reduced_repeat_policy.interpretation: qualification and trend only; no confidence interval or formal p99 claim

A.success: two remote arms finish, mixed scheduling is observed only in continuous mode, and the hybrid mixed path fails closed

B_C.success: all parent-switch cycles pass data, coverage, fault, cleanup, and module-restore checks

B_F2.entry: existing E5 PTE and stable-VA qualification runners
B_F2.success: available arms complete with matching output and no recapture/fault; unsupported arms are recorded

D.entry: existing E10/E13 qualification runner selected after static preflight
D.success: at least one grow/shrink sequence completes without OOM, fault, recapture, or invariant violation

E.entry: new read-only process/module/model inventory plus existing result metadata
E.success: GPU, host, graph, mapping, and initialization evidence can be reconciled without runtime modification

F_G.entry: existing E3/E4 stage runner at one representative coordinate
F_G.success: same frozen input completes and produces phase latency plus transport/counter evidence

H.success: stock UVM and explicit/prefetch variants complete or a semantic incompatibility is recorded

I.entry: only existing failure switches or external fault wrapper; no driver/runtime modification
I.success: injected failure is rejected or rolled back with clean module/GPU state

X.entry: existing formal E1/E2 black-box runners at a representative coordinate
X.success: common input, measured HBM, output gate, and cleanup evidence are available for every runnable arm
